questions.q: When a trader swaps against an AMM pool, who is actually on the other side of that trade?
options: The pool's reserves, deposited by liquidity providers
questions.explain: There's no order book — the trader swaps directly against reserves that liquidity providers deposited into the pool.

questions.q: Depositing 5 ETH and 10,000 USDC into a 100 ETH / 200,000 USDC pool with 1,000 LP tokens outstanding, how many new LP tokens does the pool mint you?
questions.explain: Your deposit is 5% of each existing reserve, so the pool mints 1,000 * 0.05 = 50 new LP tokens.

questions.q: How do trading fees reach LP token holders in a constant-product pool?
options: They're paid out directly to each LP's wallet after every trade
They are sent to the protocol team and distributed manually
They are burned and have no effect on LPs
They accrue into the pool's reserves, growing k, so each LP's existing share redeems a bigger amount later
questions.explain: Fees stay in the reserves rather than being paid out separately — an LP's percentage share doesn't change, but the pool (and so their redeemable amount) grows.

questions.q: Why might you redeem a different ratio of ETH and USDC than you originally deposited?
options: Because the pool's reserve ratio shifts with every trade, so redeeming later reflects the current ratio, not your original deposit ratio
Because the pool charges a withdrawal fee in a different asset
Because LP tokens expire and convert automatically
Because LP tokens can only be redeemed for a single asset
questions.explain: If ETH's price rose relative to USDC while you were an LP, the pool mechanically sold some of your ETH into USDC as trades occurred, so you redeem less ETH and more USDC than you deposited.

questions.q: What does an LP token mathematically represent?
options: A fixed dollar-denominated IOU from the protocol team
A proportional claim on the pool's reserves, equal to your LP tokens divided by total LP tokens outstanding
A voting right in the protocol's governance, unrelated to the pool's reserves
A guarantee of a fixed interest rate paid in a stablecoin
questions.explain: Your LP token balance divided by the total LP token supply gives your exact percentage claim on whatever the pool's reserves currently hold.
